name: Hikuu Yousai Mitsutsubo no Himegimi
original_name: 妃喰要塞　蜜壺の姫君
source:
Beautiful princesses are enslaved and confined in the flying Hikuyousai Fortress, spoils of the atrocious Devil King who resides within, and who has but a single depraved demand before he annihilates each of the ravaged kingdoms below.
